thread.title: Apple's stock delivers a nearly 60-point jolt to Dow industrials in early trade - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Apple's stock delivers a nearly 60-point jolt to Dow industrials in early trade - MarketWatch
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose early Wednesday, with gains coming predominantly from a record rise in the shares of Apple Inc., after the iPhone maker delivered better-than-expected fiscal third-quarter results late-Tuesday. The Dow DJIA, +0.12% was up about 61 points, or 0.3%, at 25,477, with shares of component Apple AAPL, +5.20% delivering a boost of about 75 points to the price-weighted benchmark. A $1 move in any one of the Dow's 30 components translates to a 6.8-point swing. Apple Inc. on Tuesday reported its highest-ever revenue for the three months ending in June-typically a seasonally weak quarter for the tech giant, outstripping analysts expectations for revenue and profit. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 index SPX, +0.19% rose 0.13% at 2,825, while the technology-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +0.62% advanced 0.8% at 7,729, with the index getting a boost from Apple. Apple's shares were up 5.8%, or $11, at $201.20, in early morning action, representing a record for the Cupertino, Calif.-based company.
